_comment: Each task hands the remediate skill one finding and rule-judges the remediation write-up (unified diff + verification step + effort + a reference). All context is invented and secret-free. Checks target text the model produces directly, so they hold even with tools disabled.

tasks.intent: Produce the remediation for the finding below: a unified-diff code patch (before/after), a verification step derived from the reproduction command, an effort level, and a reference.
tasks.context_excerpt:
finding:
{"id":"F-11","title":"SQL injection in user lookup","severity":"critical","type":"sqli","file":"app/users.py","line":54,"evidence":"cur.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email='\" + email + \"'\")","reproduction":{"command":"curl 'https://target/lookup?email=x%27%20OR%20%271%27%3D%271'"}}
tasks.reference: A code_patch remediation: parameterized query, a verification step, effort level, CWE-89 reference.

tasks.intent: Generate the remediation for this hardcoded-secret finding: a config_change moving the secret to an environment variable, with before/after and a verification step.
tasks.reference: A config_change remediation moving the secret to an env var + rotation note + verification.

tasks.intent: Produce the remediation for this vulnerable-dependency finding: a dependency_update with the exact upgrade command to a safe version and a verification step.
tasks.context_excerpt:
finding:
{"id":"F-13","title":"Vulnerable dependency: lodash 4.17.11 (CVE-2019-10744)","severity":"high","type":"dependency","file":"package.json","evidence":"\"lodash\": \"4.17.11\" — prototype pollution in defaultsDeep"}
tasks.reference: A dependency_update remediation: npm/yarn upgrade command to >=4.17.12 + verification.

tasks.intent: Generate the remediation for this missing-security-header finding: a config_change adding the header, before/after, effort level, and a verification step.
tasks.context_excerpt:
finding:
{"id":"F-14","title":"Missing HSTS header","severity":"low","type":"missing_header","component":"nginx reverse proxy","evidence":"Responses over HTTPS lack Strict-Transport-Security"}
tasks.reference: A config_change adding Strict-Transport-Security with a sensible max-age + verification.
